name: SSV Network
scope_note: ERC-20 governance/fee token of a DVT staking protocol; not a staked/LST/wrapped token; listed on Binance/Kraken/OKX for years. Circulating supply: on-chain totalSupply 17,361,673.6 used instead of CoinGecko 14.70M (prior analysis found CG misreports; Ethplorer availableSupply 16.32M). Percentages below are of 17.36M; against 14.70M they would be higher. CoinGecko API did not respond at read time.

D1.value: Top-10 non-excluded ~53.1% of 17.36M (excluding Binance 28 and Binance 8 only; 0x073f treated as unidentified would raise it further; even excluding 0x073f as exchange it is 53.1%)

D2.value: SSV Network proxy 0xdd9b...a4e1 (ERC1967Proxy, impl SSVNetworkSSVStakingUpgrade) holds 5,954,982 SSV = 34.30%. It is a protocol staking/deposit contract, not one of the four exclusion categories (exchange, burn, bridge escrow, readable vesting/timelock), so it counts. Its owner is the DAO Safe.
D2.source: GoPlus holders; eth.blockscout.com address API; eth_call owner()

D3.value: Liquid insider: DAO treasury Safe 5.99% + unidentified 0xb0b8 5.79% (D5) = 11.78%; plus 0x073f 7.94% if not an exchange = 19.71% (borderline vs 20%). 0x073f label not verified (Etherscan Cloudflare-blocked); prior labelled an OKX wallet but at 5.58%, a different balance.

D4.value: Insider-to-exchange flows over 90 days not traced (prior: 0xb0b8 sent 50k out 2026-09-22; its balance fell from 6.71% to 5.79% since 10-16, ~160k SSV, destination not checked)

D5.value: Unidentified wallets >=2%: 0xb0b8...7cfe 5.79% (likely SSV Labs, inference only), 0x073f...3ad7 7.94% (unverified label). Count as insiders.

E1.value: Not checked (stopped after hard fails). Prior: DIP-52 allows Foundation mints up to 1M SSV/yr (~5.8% of supply), timing discretionary.

E3.value: No max supply; circ/total ~85-100% depending on circulating figure, but not formally evaluated

E4.value: Mint allowance is discretionary; no fixed schedule verified

F2.value: is_mintable=1; owner() = 0xb350...e6b6, a GnosisSafe 5-of-9 with no modules and no guard (no timelock). Mint is at multisig discretion, not a fixed schedule or >=48h-timelocked governance.
F2.source: GoPlus; publicnode eth_call owner()/getThreshold()/getOwners()/getModulesPaginated(); guard storage slot = 0

F3.value: Owner (mint power) is a 5-of-9 Safe (>=3 signers OK) but with no >=48h timelock over supply. Not an EOA.
